scope: Complete the TD5 opposition seam with one declared two-leg structural constraint. The controller must pay and complete a lawful cp leg before a lawful n leg, with no evaluator-selected route, and the resulting relay target must equal the existing a opposition portage. This sub-batch also reruns the common FT4.2 gate; the full autonomous FT4.3 cycle remains open.
rules: Opposition is admitted only when the same-scope FT3 Demand contains the exact opposition:cp-n-v1 obligation. Missing, reordered or differently named constraints are rejected; the evaluator supplies no successful route or target.

The prospective sequence is cp then n. From relay origin p, the legs target cp(p) and n(cp(p)); the final target must equal a(p). The existing structure supplies every portage, preserves the directive coordinate and establishes that this composition reverses lap orientation.

The cp leg requires the existing exact paid orientation read of the same owned native demand before its native movement. The n leg has zero geometric fee, but its content processing is a second distinct paid native movement.

Each leg uses a deterministic child request key derived from the admitted request while preserving actor, owned demand reference, context, cue and target. Route fields remain forbidden and the unchanged native selector/executor remains authoritative.

Leg two cannot be admitted or paid before leg one's native movement succeeds. Deferral, rejection, cancellation, partial work or exhaustion records no completed leg and cannot advance the relay or start the following leg.

Every leg target must cover the exact demand requirements under unchanged seat dimensionality. An ineligible intermediate seat or unaffordable cp fee remains a visible deferred opposition attempt and starts no native work.

The controller records every structural origin/target, fee ticket, native selection and native movement. A completed opposition records both legs and the final a target; it never claims that geometric relay labels performed native content work.

Checkpoint restoration is paired to the exact native engine state and reproduces continuation. TIM, seat dimensionality, native cursor, resource defaults, native policies and earlier Full Theory source remain unchanged.

An independent auditor imports no opposition controller. It reconstructs the sequence, geometry, facet admission, cp fee, native payments, completion order, final relay and checkpoint from raw records and the accepted subordinate audits.

Acceptance requires the ten exact new methods plus all 73 exact FT4.1/FT4.2 predecessor methods, both-setting raw witnesses, strict source freeze and unchanged source. Passing accepts FT4.2 only; FT4.3 autonomous closure and reuse remains open.
gate: Eighty-three exact methods pass with zero failures/errors; canonical and workflow opposition witnesses each contain one exact cp fee, two completed paid native movements in declared order, a final a-portage relay, independent reconstruction, registered source freeze and unchanged source.
stop: Preserve failures; two gate failures after correction stops.
